run_extract_ocr_frcn_features: run the script to extract Faster R-CNN OCR features from images using an imdb file and save numpy features
load_detection_model: load a Faster R-CNN detection model from a YAML config and checkpoint file onto the GPU
extract_features: extract region features and bounding boxes from an image using a preloaded detection model with optional input boxes
process_feature_extraction: process raw detection model output to apply NMS and select top 100 highest-confidence region features
image_transform: transform an image file into a preprocessed BGR tensor with mean subtraction and scaling for detection model input
